review_responsibility.independent_wrapper_runtime_review: corridor_tracker_design_audit reviewed root-authored controller/corridor_runtime and wrote independent negative, ownership, shutdown and authority tests.
review_responsibility.independent_core_cross_review: Root independently read spatial/cascade projection and handoff, curve budgets, duplicate protections, zero-mode/PI behavior, chord-deviation semantics, grade assumptions and corridor raycast/support logic after the author tests.
review_responsibility.scope: Cross-review and finite software checks only; no navigation or physical plant acceptance.

reviewed_findings.resolution: Outer preview and inner core use the same finite-arc heading; fixed-goal tail rule, active turn lock and geometry evidence are preserved.

Original 3D projection/normal/cross/grade remain audit fields; control cross uses the new normal. New path uses real SLAM pose with 3D floor discrimination; PI/filter/command states remain owned and retained.
Default-off curvature switches are independent; enabling an infeasible reference budget returns exact zero and freezes integration; wrapper holds and requests new planning.
Root fixed resets on new request/path/goal, non-hold updates and exceptions.
Inherited shared tick already stopped on exceptions; V20 adds explicit zero-before-journal handling and finite wrapper fault coverage.
Root fixed overflowed JSON numbers and bounded nesting. Finite tests cover NaN/Inf/1e309, size/shape/state/point limits, and nonincreasing revisions.
At most one future exists, busy snapshots are counted rather than queued. Input tuple and limits are copied per job; observation provenance is separately copied before worker evaluation.
Root extended error handling to invalid/nonfinite result construction and future errors; errors are unavailable shadow diagnostics. Normal worker failures retain original path/state bindings.

Root isolated shadow polling exceptions and protected shutdown draining. Tests prove normal close drains, close failure retains original writer/ROS cleanup, arbitrary certificate contents cannot replace commands, and active/retain modes are rejected.

limits: Only shadow corridor observation is implemented. Neither old-plan retention nor corridor-based command control is enabled or validated.
The .03m chord-deviation threshold is a reference-shape fallback parameter, not obstacle clearance. Chords do not replace the checked path.
The new z reference explicitly assumes the original path normal is an equal-height direction; it is not measured terrain or foot-support proof.
Curve feedforward and speed supervisor are default-off; command slew and reference budgets do not establish Teacher physical bandwidth.

The worker has no direct control authority. Shared CPU/evidence-queue contention and live ROS callback timing still need an actual scoped experiment; original evidence-failure protections remain active.
The original 104-event screen retains fixed poses and projections; it cannot predict new gate reset counts, handoff dynamics, collision safety or navigation success.
No Gazebo, real robot, SLAM/SCAN continuous curve integration or original46 success is claimed.
